blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A joint law enforcement operation involving anti-narcotics agents and soldiers on Saturday, Nov. 14, resulted in the arrest of three persons, confiscation of firearms, explosives-related materials and illegal drugs in Barangay Gumaga, Libungan town, Cotabato. Soldiers led by Lt. Col. Germen T. Legada, commanding officer of the Army’s 33rd Infantry Battalion, and operatives of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), confiscated from the arrested suspects two M16 rifles, one 12-gauge shotgun, five rifle grenades, two 5.56mm magazine assemblies, 5.56mm ammunition, two rolls of suspected explosive wire with blasting caps, marked money, drug paraphernalia, about 15 grams of suspected […]...
